primary_endpoint: Proportion of patients developing new esophageal varices by 78 weeks (18 months).
efficacy_outcome: Reported participants with new esophageal varices: placebo 56, belapectin 2 mg/kg LBM 45, and 4 mg/kg LBM 51; denominators and statistical comparisons were not provided.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: placebo 24/118 (2 deaths); belapectin 2 mg/kg LBM 29/119 (5 deaths); belapectin 4 mg/kg LBM 26/120 (1 death).
